articles.title: Strategy proposes daily dividends to bring STRC back toward $100
articles.snippet: STRC has remained below $100 since May, despite a 12% dividend rate and roughly $1 billion in preferred share buybacks.

New York sues Polymarket, alleging it is running an illegal gambling operation
articles.snippet: The state wants to block Polymarket from operating without a gambling license and recover allegedly illegal gains.

articles.title: U.S. Federal Reserve moves on proposals to implement GENIUS Act for stablecoins
articles.snippet: The Fed proposed rules on putting last year's GENIUS Act into place with regulations, including those governing stablecoin yield programs.

articles.title: Someone was trying to sell Ondo Finance after founder Nathan Allman's death
articles.snippet: The company has vehemently denied that it was shopping for buyers. Allman’s estate declined to comment.
